facts.text: I want to make a basic website for personal viewing where I store links in a database format.
I want the website to have gallery, table, and list view options for stored links.
I want multiple properties to organize and categorize the links.
I prefer color-coded tags for categorizing links.
I want the webpage to be like a blend of a Raindrop.io page and a Notion gallery-view database.
I need HTML and CSS and possible JSON or JavaScript to set up this site.
